description: This walk takes you to the Thirlmere Infinity Pool on Fisherplace Gill above Thirlmere Reservoir. The walk starts from the car park at Legburthwaite on the north eastern side of the lake. From here you can follow the road south before climbing up to the gill. Follow the path along the gill east and it will take you past picturesque waterfalls to the inifinity pool. The pool is a popular spot for wild swimmers with a lovely waterfall and stunning views back down to the lake below. If you enjoy this walk you could also visit the infinity pool above Buttermere Lake on the Warnscale Bothy and Buttermere Infinity Pool Walk .
